title: Kalculating Damage
statementMd:
Gus and Caio Fleury are two experienced Pokémon trainers. They are preparing for the next edition of the UnBalloon Pokémon League and, for that, they are running computerized battle simulations.

The simulation software they chose computes the damage of a single attack made by one Pokémon against another. To do this, it allows choosing the type of the attacking Pokémon, $T_a$, the power of the attack used, $P$, the type of the defending Pokémon, $T_d$, and the defending Pokémon's hit points, $H$. After this attack, the Pokémon's hit points are reduced to $max(0, H - P \cdot M(T_a, T_d))$, where $M$ is the type damage modifier function. If the hit points are reduced to $0$, the Pokémon is knocked out.

Gus and Caio Fleury prefer to use the most classic types: fire $(F)$, grass $(G)$, and water $(W)$. For these specific types, the function $M$ is defined as follows:

- If $(T_a, T_d)$ $=$ $(F, G)$, $(G, W)$, or $(W, F)$, then $M(T_a, T_d) = 2$.
- Otherwise, $M = \dfrac{1}{2}$.

Caio Fleury was using the simulator extensively to decide which strategy to use in the next battle. Meanwhile, Gus was thinking about contributing to the simulator with a custom message. Denoting by $X$ the defending Pokémon's hit points after the attack, he thought of printing "Nocaute!" if $X = 0$, and "Sobraram $X$ pontos de vida!" otherwise.

However, Caio Fleury has just challenged Gus to a battle, and now there is no time to implement this message. So now it is up to you to implement it!

## Input

The first line of the input contains a single uppercase letter representing $T_a$, which can only be $F$, $G$, or $W$.

The second line also contains a single uppercase letter representing $T_d$, which can also only be $F$, $G$, or $W$.

The third line contains a single integer representing $P$ $(2 \leq P \leq 10^6)$. It is guaranteed that $P$ is even.

The fourth line also contains a single integer representing $H$ $(1 \leq H \leq 10^6)$.

## Output

Print, on a single line, the message proposed by Gus, according to the statement.
statementZhMd:
Gus 和 Caio Fleury 是两位经验丰富的宝可梦训练家。他们正在为下一届 UnBalloon 宝可梦联盟做准备，因此正在通过计算机进行对战模拟。

他们选择的模拟软件可以计算一只宝可梦对另一只宝可梦发动一次攻击所造成的伤害。为此，软件允许选择攻击方宝可梦的属性 $T_a$、所使用招式的威力 $P$、防守方宝可梦的属性 $T_d$，以及防守方宝可梦的生命值 $H$。这次攻击后，防守方宝可梦的生命值会降低至 $max(0, H - P \cdot M(T_a, T_d))$，其中 $M$ 是属性伤害修正函数。如果生命值降至 $0$，该宝可梦就会被击倒。

Gus 和 Caio Fleury 喜欢使用最经典的属性：火 $(F)$、草 $(G)$ 和水 $(W)$。对于这些属性，函数 $M$ 的定义如下：

- 如果 $(T_a, T_d)$ $=$ $(F, G)$、$(G, W)$ 或 $(W, F)$，那么 $M(T_a, T_d) = 2$。
- 否则，$M = \dfrac{1}{2}$。

Caio Fleury 一直在频繁使用模拟器，以决定下一场对战中采用什么策略。与此同时，Gus 想通过添加一条自定义消息来改进模拟器。设攻击后防守方宝可梦的生命值为 $X$，他打算在 $X = 0$ 时输出 "Nocaute!"，否则输出 "Sobraram $X$ pontos de vida!"。

然而，Caio Fleury 刚刚向 Gus 发起了对战挑战，现在已经没有时间实现这条消息了。所以，现在轮到你来实现它！

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个大写字母，表示 $T_a$，只能是 $F$、$G$ 或 $W$。

第二行也包含一个大写字母，表示 $T_d$，同样只能是 $F$、$G$ 或 $W$。

第三行包含一个整数，表示 $P$ $(2 \leq P \leq 10^6)$。保证 $P$ 是偶数。

第四行也包含一个整数，表示 $H$ $(1 \leq H \leq 10^6)$。

## 输出格式

按照题目描述，在一行中输出 Gus 提出的消息。
